description.text: The Department of Mathematics at Technion is one of the leading mathematics departments in Israel. The faculty is engaged in world-class research in both pure and applied Mathematics. The research interests include algebra, applied mathematics, approximation theory, combinatorics, complex analysis, differential equations, ergodic theory, functional analysis, geometry and topology, linear algebra, nonlinear analysis, number theory, optimization theory, and probability theory. The Center for Mathematical Sciences (CMS) was founded at the department in 1988. Since then it supports a large variety of research activities, conferences, special lecture series, workshops, etc.

duration.text: The Mathematics with Computer Science at Israel Institute of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 14583 USD/per year ￥ 105000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Your application must include the following documents:• Completed Application Form including a passport sized photo• Health Declaration Form• Secondary school diploma and transcripts covering three years (students should have a strong background in math/science. A background in Physics is mandatory)• Two teacher recommendation letters*• Standardized test (SAT or ACT or AST) according to the student’s country of origin• Resume/CV• Personal statement• Students who are non-native English speakers must also submit English proficiency test scores, either TOEFL or IELTS (see below for required minimum and recommended score)• $100 (USD) non-refundable application fee* An original copy must be sent to the Admissions Office directly from the evaluator. At least one letter should be from a mathematics or science teacher.

requirements.text: English Proficiency TestSince the academic program at GTIIT is taught in English, applicants are required to demonstrate their English proficiency before they enroll. Applicants from high schools where English is not the primary language of instruction are required to submit official copies of their scores on the TOEFL, IELTS, the SAT Reasoning, or ACT Plus Writing Test.Required Scores on English Proficiency Tests Test TypeRecommended ScoreMinimum scoreTOEFL- Internet Based Test (IBT)8580IELTS6.56.0 Candidates applying from the USA or from high schools taught according to the American system, must take a standardized test (SAT or ACT) before applying. GTIIT has minimum test score requirements for the math section as detailed below. Those who take tests in other subjects may send their results in as well.Required Scores on Standardized TestsTest TypeRecommended ScoreMinimum scoreSAT- Math section700660ACT- Math section3028
